title: Bull
summary: Bull is a dark-blue taurine Titan dressed in chitinous, beetle-like armor. Glowing with blue energy, its armor and three silver horns give it a cybernetic, futuristic appearance. As its name bluntly suggests, Bull Titans are wild elemental forces of primal instinct - chaotic, unruly, and untiring.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Bull Titans are commonly found in Pamplona, Spain. {{Source|TCG:SAS-150|SAS-150}}

A herd of wild Bulls once ran riot during Pamplona's famous festival, the running of the Bulls, and attacked the bull fighters. The Huntik team were given a difficult mission to corral them in order to subdue them. {{Source|TCG:SAS-150|SAS-150}}

full_text:
Bull is a dark-blue taurine Titan dressed in chitinous, beetle-like armor. Glowing with blue energy, its armor and three silver horns give it a cybernetic, futuristic appearance. As its name bluntly suggests, Bull Titans are wild elemental forces of primal instinct - chaotic, unruly, and untiring.

== History ==
Bull Titans are commonly found in Pamplona, Spain. [TCG:SAS-150]

A herd of wild Bulls once ran riot during Pamplona's famous festival, the running of the Bulls, and attacked the bull fighters. The Huntik team were given a difficult mission to corral them in order to subdue them. [TCG:SAS-150]

== Abilities ==
Bull Titans can charge at opponents with immense speed and impale their enemies with their sharp horns. Its "Adrenaline Surge" ability lets it channel a sudden burst of overwhelming energy, preventing it from tiring and giving it the momentum to take out a target. [TCG:SAS-175]
